content.text: The evidence clearly shows a feature flag rollout: `monthly-spend-feature` going from off toward on (40% at 21:35, fully on by 21:36), correlating exactly with the ZeroDivisionError onset and error rate spike. No code deployment or config change occurred. This is a clean feature-flag-toggle case.

hypotheses.subject: monthly-spend-feature
hypotheses.summary: The feature flag monthly-spend-feature was toggled on (rolling out from 0% to 100% between 21:35 and 21:36), which triggered a ZeroDivisionError in src/io_shop/spend_summary.py:47 on the account page code path. Error rate jumped from ~1% baseline to 33%+ in lockstep with the flag rollout, while p50/p95/p99 latency and cpu/memory stayed flat, consistent with a flag toggle rather than a resource or traffic problem.
